work_info.title: What is Mobile Photo Editing?
descriptions: Mobile Photo Editing is the professional enhancement of smartphone images to improve lighting, colors, and overall visual balance while preserving a natural look. Each image is manually reviewed and refined to avoid over-processed results and maintain authenticity.

list.content: Lighting & Color Correction: Adjusting exposure and tones for clean, natural visuals.
Skin Tone & Detail Refinement: Enhancing portraits without artificial filters.
Background & Distraction Cleanup: Removing unwanted elements for better composition.
Manual Precision Editing: Customized edits instead of template-based filters.
Natural Look Preservation: Ensuring images remain realistic and true to the moment.
